claims.proof: The canonical work convention counts matrix FMA as two, dot reductions in scalar recurrence as multiply plus n-1 adds, and each typed basic scalar operation once. Projection/full attention/vocabulary/scalar/causal convolution/GDN prefill/GDN decode/draft dependency families are disjoint. Special functions and comparisons are disclosed separately, not silently called FLOPs.

Fresh request prefixes and no preemption imply necessary target positions0..P+O-2 exactly once. First39 layers produce the entire last-layer KV prefix. The final full-attention layer needs full Q/output/MoE/final norm only at retained target logits or same-position first-pass MTP hidden roots. K/V and its normalized input remain necessary for all prefix rows; final Q/full populations are the union, not all rows unconditionally.

Pinned sequential MTP2 has no parallel drafting, extra first-pass slots, CP remapping or auxiliary target hidden concatenation. With complete native outputs and no formal preemption/reset/abort, nonterminal c equals accepted+1. Terminal trimming retains accepted drafts between c-1 and min(2,c); both branches are closed independently. An empty terminal publication is rejected as outside the domain.

Both admitted source families select target token/position/hidden rows with the same indices, shift input token IDs only, and copy target hidden states into first-pass buffers without position reindexing. Target returns its final normalized hidden state. MTP applies two pre-FC norms, concat-FC, one full-attention/MoE decoder, then final norm. Later draft steps recycle the selected prior full hidden state and sampled token.

Draft writes are causal ordered prefixes. A later first pass overwrites its own suffix; last-writer versions preserve earlier prefix owners. Backward closure starts only at retained/possibly-retained terminal draft vocabulary roots, adds full hidden and KV-prefix ancestors, and follows previous-step hidden/token dependencies. KV-only first-pass rows require input norms/FC/K/V, not their dead Q/attention/MoE/vocabulary. Earlier prompt partitions cover the same step0 logical prefix; unused boundary predictions and overwritten suffixes are not roots.

r8 role metadata separates non-speculative prompt rows from MTP verification regardless of length. Prompt WY segments partition each fresh prompt into real1..64 zero-first/stateful-later chunks; all ordered compositions form a conservative superset. original018 can additionally classify a one-token non-speculative prompt remainder as recurrence. Its envelope includes that option, with cold structural-zero arithmetic removed explicitly. Decode after the prompt uses the fixed recurrent verification family. No old chunk histogram is imported.

Frozen Qwen3.5 BF16 unquantized TP2 has attention gating, Gemma RMS norms epsilon1e-6, partial RoPE64, SiLU, causal convolution width4, top8 of256 experts, normalized softmax routing and one shared expert; no attention bias, layer-scale, sequence-parallel or expert-redundancy branch. Global semantic arithmetic is counted once rather than charging TP-replicated scalar execution twice.

A completed separately instrumented r8 companion observation must validate loaded target/draft shapes and scalar dispatch on both ranks, and show every actual request-owned producer closure lies within its own public-reconstructed terminal interval. Companion token counts/times do not replace native counts/times. This supplements source qualification; it does not demand native and HTTP generated tokens match.

The source-pinned get_rope caches identical immutable rotary configurations. named_modules removes duplicate objects, so the inventory validates the first shared rotary object and all distinct parameter-owning modules; later omitted rotary aliases are covered by the constructor/cache source binding.
